points.text: Studies show that how we were loved or unloved between the ages of 0 to 5 impact the next 15, 25, 50 years of our life.
The speaker's parents, a comedian and a photographer, were always home with their children.
The speaker feels that their family foundation was solid, which is why they dream of having kids and being a present dad.
The speaker's dad, as a comedian, has a volatile job with extreme highs and lows, but the children never saw that side of him.
The speaker feels connected and safe within their family unit due to their parents being a solid team.
The critics hated the speaker's show, "The Crowded Room", but it doesn't upset them.
The speaker thinks their ability to handle criticism comes from their dad, who can brush off a bad gig and move on.
Getting bad reviews and perceptions can affect people, and the speaker's ability to shrug it off is seen as amazing.
Many people are scared of what others will say, which holds them back from chasing their dreams.
The speaker's parents have opened up about the challenges they faced as the children grew older.
The speaker's dad is good at handling the effects of his job, which has influenced the speaker's own ability to handle challenges.
The speaker thinks that dealing with criticism and challenges is something you can get better at, and having a strong support group helps.
The speaker loves shows with mystery and puzzles, such as Christopher Nolan movies.
The speaker watches Chris Ramsey's videos to relax, as he solves puzzles and opens Japanese puzzle boxes.
The speaker is not good at solving puzzles, but enjoys watching others do it.
